# Pravara Mes Full LLM Context

Generated: 2026-05-13 (curated 2026-10-02)

## Purpose

This file gives LLM agents a stable, tool-agnostic map for working in this
repository without depending on vendor-specific instruction files.

## Canonical instruction order

1. `AGENTS.md`
2. `README.md` if present
3. `ECOSYSTEM.md` if present
4. Relevant files under `docs/`, `infra/`, `.github/workflows/`, and source
   directories for the specific task

## Agent compatibility

`AGENTS.md` is the source of truth. `CLAUDE.md` exists only to redirect Claude
and other legacy agent integrations to `AGENTS.md`.

## Enclii-first operations contract

Use Enclii web, API, or CLI for routine production provisioning, deployment,
observability, domain management, secrets, provider operations, scaling,
rollback, and remediation.

Raw `kubectl`, `helm`, SSH, provider CLIs/APIs, `docker exec`, and direct
container access are allowed only for platform bootstrap or documented
break-glass emergencies when Enclii is unavailable or lacks an implemented
adapter. Any break-glass use must record the actor, reason, target
service/environment, commands executed, result, and follow-up Enclii adapter
gap or incident link.

## Repository map (verified against `main`, 2026-10-02)

- `apps/pravara-api` (Go/Gin): REST API under `/v1`, behind a Janua OIDC JWT
  or an `X-API-Key`. Hosts the order→task decomposition, capability-based
  assignment, event outbox and outbound webhook dispatcher
  (`X-Pravara-Signature: sha256=<hex>`), plus inbound webhooks for Cotiza,
  Dhanam, ForgeSight and Tezca. Native MCP `POST /mcp`
  (`internal/mcp`, `internal/api/mcp_*.go`): off unless
  `PRAVARA_MCP_ENABLED=true` (the owner turns it on); Janua machine tokens
  with `pravara-cogs:read` only; read tools `mes_job_consumption` and
  `mes_inventory_levels` (quantities only, no money), each the same read as
  its HTTP route; coverage contract `MCPCoverage()` with a CI drift guard.
  See `docs/operations/native-mcp.md`. Cost events
  (`internal/costevents`): job consumption pushed to Dhanam's
  `POST /v1/cost-events` as quantity-only `consumption` events (source
  `pravara`, never money; Dhanam values them, ruling C12), through the
  tenant-scoped outbox `cost_event_outbox` (migration 034), off unless
  `PRAVARA_COST_EVENTS_ENABLED=true` (owner only); `item.material_code` is
  the material registry code. See `docs/operations/cost-events.md`.
  Inventory (RFC 0058 wave 1, migration 035): material code registry owned
  by Pravara, aliases, unit conversions (never guessed: a quantity with no
  conversion is a listed gap and moves no stock), receipts with invoice
  evidence, batch lots linked to stock, physical counts whose differences
  are their own `adjustment`; quantities only. See
  `docs/operations/inventory.md`.
- `apps/telemetry-worker` (Go): MQTT telemetry ingest and machine command
  dispatch.
- `apps/pravara-ui` (Next 15.5), `apps/pravara-landing` (Next 15.5, public
  site root), `apps/admin` (Next 16.3, pravara-admin).
- `apps/pravara-gateway`: Centrifugo configuration for real-time fan-out.
- Not deployed: `apps/visualization-engine`, `apps/machine-adapter` (Go,
  in `go.work`); `apps/video-streaming` (Go, not in `go.work`, does not
  build); `apps/ml-orchestrator`, `apps/octoprint-connector` (Python);
  `apps/luban-bridge` (Node).
- `packages/sdk-go`: shared Go types.
- `infra/k8s/production`: the overlay Argo CD syncs. It renders the
  resources listed in `infra/k8s/base/kustomization.yaml`.

## Deploy path

Merging to `main` is the deploy. `.github/workflows/build-deploy.yml`
(path-filtered) and `.github/workflows/deploy-admin.yml` build and sign the
images and commit their digests to `infra/k8s/production/kustomization.yaml`.
Argo CD auto-syncs that overlay. Docs-only changes trigger no build.

## Tests

Commands and the list of CI-gated suites: README.md «Testing». Suites not
in CI (admin, luban-bridge, octoprint-connector, ml-orchestrator) and their
known failures are tracked in the pending-work list below.

## Cross-repo contracts

README.md «Related repositories / contracts» is the table. It links the doc
that defines each contract on the other side (Janua, digifab-quoting/Cotiza,
phynd-crm, tezca, enclii). Two contracts have known drift: Cotiza → Pravara
dispatch, and the Pravara → PhyndCRM signature header.

## Pending work and roadmap

The single canonical list is ROADMAP.md «Pending work and roadmap ahead»
(priorities P0–P3; owner decision vs engineering; links). Do not copy it
here; read it there.

## Maintenance

These files are maintained by `internal-devops/scripts/sync-agent-docs.py`.
If repo-specific long-form agent guidance is needed, put it in `AGENTS.md`,
not `CLAUDE.md`.
